title: Bubble Sort
problemStatement: Sort an array using Bubble Sort (with optimized early exit).
intuition: Repeatedly swap adjacent out-of-order pairs; each pass bubbles the next maximum to the end. If a pass does zero swaps, the array is sorted — early exit.

approaches.title: Bubble sort (optimized)
approaches.idea: n-1 passes; shrink unsorted suffix; break if no swaps.
approaches.time: O(n²) worst / avg; O(n) best when already sorted
approaches.whyWorks: After k passes, the k largest elements are in the last k positions.

complexity.time: O(n²) worst; O(n) best with flag

commonMistakes: Wrong j range causing index errors
interviewInsight: Mention best-case O(n) with swap flag — shows you know adaptive behavior.
